description: Implement Wallet, Notifications, Messages, and remaining supporting screens. Final cleanup, commit, and push to origin Rexo-Kotlin.
steps: Create lib/features/wallet/screens/wallet_screen.dart - wallet overview: balance card (available + escrow), recent transactions list, action buttons (Deposit, Withdraw). Premium gradient balance card.
Create lib/features/wallet/screens/deposit_screen.dart - deposit form: amount, payment method (UPI), transaction ref, upload proof screenshot. Submits to deposits table.
Create lib/features/wallet/screens/withdraw_screen.dart - withdrawal form: amount, method (UPI/Bank), payout details JSON. Submits to withdrawals table.
Create lib/features/wallet/providers/wallet_provider.dart - providers for wallet balance, transactions, deposit, withdraw
Create lib/features/notifications/screens/notifications_screen.dart - notifications list from Supabase notifications table, mark as read, grouped by date, swipe to dismiss
Create lib/features/notifications/providers/notifications_provider.dart - providers for notifications list, mark read, delete
Create lib/features/messages/screens/messages_screen.dart - conversation list showing recent messages grouped by other user
Create lib/features/messages/screens/chat_screen.dart - individual chat with message bubbles, text input, send to Supabase messages table
Create lib/features/messages/providers/messages_provider.dart - providers for conversations, messages in a conversation, send message
Add wallet, notifications, and messages routes to lib/core/router/app_router.dart
Create lib/features/campaigns/screens/my_campaigns_screen.dart - for brands: list of their posted campaigns. For creators: list of their applications with status badges.
Ensure all routes are connected and navigation works end-to-end
Run final verification: check all dart files exist, check for obvious syntax errors (unclosed braces, missing semicolons)
Git add all new files, remove all deleted files, commit with message 'feat: complete Flutter conversion - Rexo Marketplace', push to origin Rexo-Kotlin
acceptance_criteria: Wallet screen displays balance from Supabase wallets table
Deposit and withdraw screens create records in respective Supabase tables
Notifications screen fetches from notifications table and supports mark-as-read
Messages screen supports real-time-like chat via Supabase
All routes are properly defined in app_router.dart
All changes are committed and pushed to origin Rexo-Kotlin branch
No Kotlin/Gradle files remain in the repository
The Flutter project structure is complete and coherent
verification: Run: git log --oneline -3 to confirm commit exists
Run: git diff --stat origin/Rexo-Kotlin to confirm push succeeded (should show nothing)
Run: find . -name '*.kt' to confirm no Kotlin files remain
Run: find lib -name '*.dart' | wc -l to confirm substantial number of dart files created (should be 30+)
